name: mcp-toolshed
description: MCP tools for making restricted parts of the web accessible to agents, served from Cloudflare Workers

scripts.deploy:preview: wrangler versions upload --preview-alias preview-$(git rev-parse --short=8 HEAD) ${REPOSITORY_URL:+--var "REPOSITORY_URL:$REPOSITORY_URL"}

REPOSITORY_URL.description: URL of your copy of this repository, sent in the User-Agent so the platforms' API operators can tell whose deployment is calling. Leave empty to send none.
